name: Michishirube Consulting
description: Michishirube Consulting — a management consulting firm theme set as a vertical scroll: under a formal top header (firm name, tagline and a Book a first call button), the menu leaves the bar on wide screens and becomes a fixed midnight-navy side rail down the left edge with numbered entries set horizontally in every language, hairline dividers and a brass marker on the current page; phones get a full-screen navy overlay menu with large entries. Deep navy (#1E3A5F) is the main colour, chosen for trust: the hero, the story band and every page head are navy fields set in white, with mist blue-grey panels, cloud-white grounds and a muted brass accent kept to small rules and markers; in Chinese and Japanese a short vertical line beside the hero title is the only tategaki touch. The hero is a cut-out object breaking its frame: the title, lead and buttons on the left, a framed low-key photograph of an empty boardroom at dusk on the right, and a cut-out consultant (transparent WebP) standing over the frame's corner and dropping past the hero bottom edge; a cut-out brass compass breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a realistic low-key photograph (50mm f/1.4, one hard window light, deep shadows) of a modern, international office. BIZ UDMincho for display, Crimson Pro for reading, Noto Serif TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: 1.0.1 (issue #185): the main colour changed from shikon violet #3F2A5E to deep navy #1E3A5F for a more trustworthy look (design-plan row b5-7 updated to match), with a muted brass #C9A66B accent for small markers only; the photos were re-graded from violet to navy. The Chinese and Japanese side rail no longer sets its entries top to bottom (writing-mode vertical-rl turned it into a row of narrow columns): every language now uses the same horizontal numbered rail with a current-page marker, and zh/ja section titles are horizontal too; the only vertical text left is the short tategaki line beside the hero title. Otherwise built to design-plan.json row b5-7 (tategaki-vertical-scroll, cutout-break-frame-object hero, side-rail nav, real-photography, low-key photo direction, BIZ UDMincho + Crimson Pro, business-services). A formal top header with the firm name, tagline and the Book a first call button; on wide screens the menu becomes a fixed side rail. Break-frame: the cut-out consultant breaks out of the framed hero photo and the hero bottom edge; the cut-out brass compass breaks over the story band and page heads. Contrast: white #FFFFFF on navy #1E3A5F 11.5:1 (all text on the hero, story band, every page head, navy buttons and step badges); pale steel blue #BFD0E3 on navy 7.3:1 (labels on the fields); paper #F5F7FA on ink #0E1B2E 16.1:1 and pale steel blue on ink 11.0:1 (side rail, overlay menu, footer); ink on paper 16.1:1 and on mist #E6ECF3 14.5:1; indigo #2A5585 on paper 7.2:1 and on mist 6.5:1 (links); white on indigo 7.7:1; quiet #4A5868 on paper 6.8:1 and on mist 6.1:1; brass #C9A66B on ink 7.5:1 (current-page numeral) and on navy 5.0:1, otherwise decorative only (rail edge, header rule, current-item marker); ink is never used on navy.
